title: 高分子有限变形后斜裂突断（半脆半韧预期）

implementation.scope: one qualitative weak deformation candidate, not a calibrated plastic/elastic material response

streams.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

source.observed_event_basis: source dense-frame review communicated by main agent; author directly saw source intact4.68 and separated4.93, with rapid rupture between consecutive source diagnostic frames

time_mapping.strategy: retimed20s qualitative demonstration, source is only5.3333s; no constant speed source reconstruction

reference_anchors.role: last clearly intact inspected source anchor, author timeline allocation
approximate visual source event vs authored full-cut event, not quantitative kinetic mapping

simulation_stages.description: weak authored local stretch and coupled section reduction, plastic fraction unknown
rapid inclined/jagged crack opens under loading while finite residual connection remains
last finite connection cut with identical unique material coordinates and fixture positions
selected stop condition, no postfracture geometry movement

observations: Source white narrow flat strip with gradual shoulder transition; extensometer and caption partly obscure specimen.
Source has rapid short oblique/jagged separation, end fragments remain held by their respective jaws.
Inspected4.63/4.68 frames do not clearly show complete rupture;4.93/end frames show separation.
No clear stable plastic zone or strong localized neck comparable to black high-extension source0097 is visible.
Finite extension and section-change magnitude cannot be reliably quantified from the source camera/occlusion.
author_assumptions: Weak finite deformation and slight local thinning are a qualitative author extension, not source-measured plastic deformation.
Maximum local stretch1.08, relative thickness0.16 and shoulder/gauge dimensions are discrete author geometry choices.
Axial integration and inverse-square-root transverse scaling approximately preserve material volume under loading; no resin-specific plastic law or modulus is identified.
Oblique/short jagged complementary crack surface and front-to-rear/lateral propagation are simplified geometry.
The original source label half-brittle/half-ductile is expected only; oblique fracture and authored weak thinning cannot verify mixed-mode mechanism.
Upper loading and lower fixed boundary chosen for demonstration; exact source machine control and compliance unresolved.
Postfracture stop selected; source brief post-event interval does not establish zero physical recoil or controller delay.
Tiny rear central newly cut surface patch remains in unbonded zero-opening contact; actual vertex indices and graph distinguish this from bonded material.
No deleted material, no complete-fragment rigid jump at the final cut, no post-cut axial shrinking to generate the gap.
Only fixtures and specimen shown; source extensometer is omitted for visibility.
unknowns: Exact polymer resin, grade, temperature, rate and composition.
Elastic/plastic strain partition, permanence of local section reduction and material strength.
Source formal gauge, actual thickness, width, physical scale and camera projection calibration.
Microscopic fracture mechanism and basis underlying original mixed-mode annotation.
Real crack path through thickness, fracture kinetics, source actuator delay and residual motion.
Force balance, contact pressure, arbitrary full-triangle self intersection and quantitative material dynamics not solved.

complete_config.applicability: one weak finite-deformation white polymer rapid oblique rupture qualitative candidate; mixed-mode label unverified
complete_config.units: relative author coordinates, no mm scale
complete_config.transverse_scale: inverse sqrt of local axial stretch, approximate constant material volume
complete_config.stretch_shape: 0.3 uniform contribution plus0.7 Gaussian centered-0.15, width0.42, tapered to zero near grips
complete_config.selected_postfracture_condition: stop all geometry and fixtures from first separated frame; no additional recoil or bending
complete_config.view: fixtures and specimen only; no machine frame or backdrop
complete_config.longitudinal_mapping: trapezoid integral of local lambda from-2.4 to z on400intervals; shared mapping used for both halves; linear interpolation between grid values
complete_config.thickness_equation: h=0.16/sqrt(lambda); unchanged at embedded ends where mask0
complete_config.upper_crack_displacement: delta_z=0.055*p*(w+(1-w)*t), t=(z-fracture_surface)/(2.4-fracture_surface); applied under continuous loading before full cut
complete_config.last_cut: seam shared vertices and internal faces identify finite connection before481; from481 duplicate vertices on complementary cut faces, preserve coordinates; zero-opening rear contact unbonded
complete_config.upper_fixture_motion: follows mapped material upper endpoint plus crack-loading travel; lower fixed
complete_config.scene_saved_scope: scene_final_state.blend is final state only; generator independently reconstructs full600-frame sequence
